review_scope: static production/test review plus read-only inspection of retained red-v1/green-v1 results; no candidate, unit test, session, executor, game, X, or formal run executed by reviewer

red.interpretation: pre-repair tests reproduce duplicate identity, fabricated producer field assumptions, weak input validation, and absent real-producer composition support; retained unchanged

green.interpretation: all projector and composition cases pass; five composition scenarios include normal two-key batch, retry, cancellation, duplicate release, and cross-step rejection

confirmed_properties: release matching consumes each identity once and rejects unmatched admissions
identity values are type-checked before tuple dictionary use; malformed values fail closed
batch grouping includes owner, token, batch id, and batch step; positions must be exact contiguous integer ordinals and size must match
admission acknowledgement, common deadline, caller/owner receipt times, retry ordering, final key-up state, and post-batch state ordering are checked
the ordinary regression rejects bool as attempt ordinal and other int-valued booleans
producer composition fixture uses synthetic Xlib with actual V12 owner, V3/V4 wrappers, and batch backend raw/publisher; direct raw dispatch is used, not backend execute or session loop
limitations: same-step/same-deadline identity scope is explicit; cross-step hold pairing remains not-ready
fake-X composition does not run Session, Executor, V39 main loop, program parser/lowering, V15 main, or game
not evidence of physical input, application consumption, latency bound, or MAP01 benefit
the #8132 boolean-ordinal property is included as ordinary regression coverage; it is not a separate formal discovery
